# Vendored Tailwind browser runtime

- Package: `@tailwindcss/browser`
- Version: `4.3.3`
- Source: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4.3.3/dist/index.global.js>
- SHA-256: `a60c785630a06196808cbe79e6f7bdb4abcc8f4421a47b56f29338fc84805e3b`
- License: MIT

`render-diagram.cjs` intercepts the matching CDN URL and serves this local file.
The generated HTML therefore remains easy to preview in a normal browser, while PNG rendering does not depend on network access.
